newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Afghan alliance bombs Kabul airport.
newsitem.headline: Afghan alliance bombs Kabul airport.

text.p: Warplanes apparently belonging to a northern alliance opposed to the Taleban militia bombed Kabul twice on Thursday morning, aiming for the airport, witnesses said.
The aircraft swooped down from the north and the Taleban defenders of the Afghan capital sent up a heavy barrage of anti-aircraft fire and at least one ground-to-air missile, they said.
It was not immediately clear what the bombs struck in the two raids.
Previous raids over the weekend failed to damage the airport, which is used for both civilian and military traffic. One of the previous bombs landed in a city centre park.
